subject: Draft: MAP + 30-day evaluation flightplan for CobaltData
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@cobaltdata.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Draft: MAP + 30-day evaluation flightplan for CobaltData

Hi Ellen —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Per our discussion, I’m attaching a lightweight MAP (mutual action plan) draft that lays out a 30-day evaluation flightplan focused on the two success criteria you highlighted: (1) inference latency consistency under concurrent traffic and (2) model reproducibility across dev and staging.

Quick summary of what’s in the draft:
- Week 0: Kickoff + access (API keys, sample dataset handoff, firewall rules)
- Week 1: Baseline perf & small-scale integration (sample queries, KV cache check)
- Week 2: Scale tests + quantization recommendations (throughput profile, cost estimates)
- Week 3: Acceptance runbook + production-readiness checklist (SLO targets, rollback plan)
- Owners: single-point owners for infra, app integration, and security

Attachments: CobaltData-MAP-flightplan-v1.gdoc (link below) and a one-slide weekly checklist.

Next steps I propose:
1) You review the doc and mark owners where needed (I added suggested owners in the right column).
2) If the timeline works, let’s lock a 60-minute kickoff on Tue (4/14) to share credentials and run the Week 0 checklist.

Is Tue 4/14 at 10am PT OK for Ellen + your infra lead?

Best,
Nikhil

Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
https://redwoodinference.com

Attachments: CobaltData-MAP-flightplan-v1.gdoc (Google Doc) — https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-CobaltData-MAP-v1

From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@cobaltdata.com>

Cc: Procurement <procurement@cobaltdata.com>
Date: 2026-04-11T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft: MAP + 30-day evaluation flightplan for CobaltData

Thanks, Nikhil — this looks sensible. Two quick items from my side:
1) Our infra lead (same as last time) can do Tue 4/14 at 10am PT. I’ll add them to the calendar invite after we confirm.
2) For acceptance criteria, can you add an item that captures: "95th percentile latency under a 50 RPS sustained load must be < 220ms"? That’s our internal SLT for this evaluation.

I’ll review the doc and mark owners by EOD Monday. Procurement is looped for any SOC2/commercial questions but we’re not ready to discuss pricing until the initial run.

—Ellen
Ellen Park
Head of Platform Engineering, CobaltData
ellen.park@cobaltdata.com | +1 (206) 555-0123

Subject: Re: Draft: MAP + 30-day evaluation flightplan for CobaltData

Thanks Ellen — great call-to-action. I updated the MAP to include your acceptance threshold (95th < 220ms) and pre-seeded owners per Marissa’s note. Key changes:
- Acceptance criteria: added the 95th percentile latency target and a short test harness definition (endpoint, query mix).
- Week 0 checklist: Jasmine will provision the short-lived API key and share host allowlist steps in the kickoff.
- Week 2 scale tests: Ben will own the 50 RPS sustained ramp and capture token-cost delta per model variant.
- Added an explicit "Decision to move to PoC" gate at Day 21 with required artifacts (perf report, integration notes, compliance checklist).

I attached the updated doc and the one-slide checklist. Ellen, I’ve tentatively scheduled Tue 4/14 10am PT for kickoff and sent a calendar invite to you and your infra lead. Please accept or propose another time if needed.

Link to updated MAP: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-CobaltData-MAP-v1 (CobaltData-MAP-flightplan-v1.gdoc)
